items.title: Jakirovic full of praise for Tzolakis performance
items.description: Hull head coach Sergej Jakirovic is pleased with his side's "precise" counter-attacking to earn a victory over Brighton, and describes goalkeeper Konstantinos Tzolakis' performance as "unbelievable."

items.title: Arsenal booed after another home WSL draw as Man Utd beat Blues
items.description: Arsenal were booed by their fans after they held to a sixth successive draw at home, drawing 0-0 with West Ham in the Women's Super League.

items.title: Big wins as Celtic, Rangers, City & Hearts progress
items.description: Holders Celtic as well as Rangers, Glasgow City, Hearts, Montrose, Aberdeen and Falkirk progress with big wins in the Women's Scottish Cup.

items.title: Spurs 'a match for anyone' as win at Man City boosts European hopes
items.description: With the Women's Super League big four firmly established, and London City Lionesses spending their way into European contention, Champions League dreams could have seemed more fanciful than ever for Tottenham Hotspur. But they are firmly in the mix.
